$comment: contract-version 0.1.0 — ROOT-LEVEL credential/privilege SSOT. Defines the credential TYPES a box/process holds and the FORMAT of each (canonical env var name, aliases, grants, holder, where-forbidden). The management-MCP env subset is ONE consumer of this taxonomy, not the top of it. This exists because the org credential's env-key NAME drifted across three repos (core set MOLECULE_ORG_API_KEY, the runtime forwarded the unprefixed ORG_API_KEY, mcp-server read MOLECULE_ORG_API_KEY) with nothing forcing agreement, AUTH_ERROR-ing the concierge. This contract is the forcing function; core/runtime/mcp-server vendor it and a drift gate fails CI on a name mismatch.
title: Credential / Privilege Model Contract
description: SSOT JSON-Schema (draft 2020-12) for Molecule's credential taxonomy. The SDK owns the SHAPE (privilege types + canonical env-key format); implementations set/forward/read these keys in molecule-core, molecule-ai-workspace-runtime, molecule-mcp-server, molecule-controlplane. Privilege POWER is coarse today (org-api-key == admin == full tenant admin); this contract pins NAMES + delivery, not (yet) fine-grained scoping.

credentials.description: The credential taxonomy. Each entry is one privilege type + its canonical env-key format.

routing.description: Non-credential identity/routing env vars the credentials ride alongside (org id, slug, tenant vs CP URL).

management_mcp_env.description: The exact env a privileged management MCP child must receive. The drift seam that caused the concierge AUTH_ERROR — const-pinned so core (setter), runtime (forward-allowlist), and mcp-server (reader) cannot disagree.

required.description: The management MCP MUST receive all of these under exactly these names. MOLECULE_ORG_API_KEY = tool auth; MOLECULE_API_KEY = preflight; the two are distinct and both required.

deprecated_do_not_use.description: The unprefixed ORG_API_KEY: an old runtime-allowlist name set/read by nobody. Its presence-without-a-producer is exactly the bug — do not reintroduce it as canonical.
